about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Engineer · Designer-minded · Team player
paragraphs: I'm a senior frontend engineer with 8+ years of experience shipping production apps for startups and enterprise teams. I care deeply about performance budgets, design systems, and inclusive UX.

My sweet spot is React ecosystems, design tokens, and turning ambiguous product goals into shippable milestones. I mentor engineers, collaborate closely with design, and document decisions so teams move faster.
When I'm not coding, I contribute to open source, write about web performance, and speak at local meetups about accessibility and Core Web Vitals.
